about_short_description.short_description: United Fidelity is an insurance company which offers motor, medical, home, travel and marine insurance services.

product.name: Motor Insurance
product.description: Provides coverage for loss, damage, and third-party liability related to motor vehicles, including accidental collision, theft, and fire.

product.name: Health Insurance
product.description: Offers monetary protection for medical treatment expenses due to illness or accidents, including inpatient and outpatient care.

product.name: Home Insurance
product.description: Covers protection for home contents, buildings, personal belongings, and liabilities related to domestic helpers and tenants.

product.name: Pet Insurance
product.description: Provides insurance coverage for veterinary expenses, death benefits, theft, and third-party liability for dogs and cats.

product.name: Travel Insurance
product.description: Provides coverage for risks associated with travel, including medical emergencies and trip interruptions.

product.name: Marine Insurance
product.description: Covers risks related to marine cargo and pleasure crafts, including loss or damage during transit or ownership.
